Item 2.    Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
Net sales for the second quarter of 2024 increased 4% compared to the same quarter of 2023, primarily due to higher sales of Beacon software subscriptions. Gross margin percentage was 41.2%, compared to 40.5% in the prior-year quarter, reflecting a more favorable product mix.
Segment Operating Performance
Americas net sales increased 6% driven by energy customers in Texas. Europe net sales decreased 2% due to weaker industrial demand in Germany.

PART II — OTHER INFORMATION
Item 1.    Legal Proceedings
In February 2024, the court granted the Company’s motion to dismiss the Sensorium LLC patent lawsuit.
Item 1A.    Risk Factors
Except as set forth below, there have been no material changes to the risk factors disclosed in Part I, Item 1A of the 2023 Form 10-K.
New export restrictions could limit sales of Atlas controllers in China.
In January 2024, the U.S. government announced additional export restrictions on advanced industrial control equipment. These rules could prevent the Company from selling certain Atlas controllers to customers in China, which represented approximately 7% of net sales in 2023.
Item 2.    Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities and Use of Proceeds
The Company repurchased 1.2 million shares of its common stock during the quarter for $96 million.
